points: Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending **-ой** if stressed: **новый** — **молодой**; **русский** — **плохой**, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.
All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.
The adjective «**большой**» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its **-ш**-: **большого**, **большому**, **большим**, **о большом**.
Ordinal numerals (except «**третий**») are declined like "hard" adjectives.

blocks.text: Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending **-ой** (**-ей**) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative. In spite of **-ш-**, «**большая**» belongs to the guttural type: **большой**, **большую**.

«**твой, твоё, твоя**» are declined like «**мой**», «**ваш**» like «**наш**». All possessives (with the exception of fixed forms «**его, её, их**») always agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify: *Я пишу твоим пером. Я видел твоего брата.* but: *Я пишу его пером. Я видел его брата.*
Further sentences, so that every pattern above is practised: from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English.

exercises.q: ___ (тот, prep. sg. n.) выждал момент перед ответом.
exercises.prompt: Tom waited a moment before replying.
exercises.why: **тот → том** (prep. sg. n., agreeing with момент). «тот» has its own declension (not the regular adjective pattern). Its forms (n. sg.): то · того · тому · то · тем · том.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Несомненное достоинство автоматических дверей в ___ (тот, prep. sg. n.), что люди больше не разносят заразу через дверные ручки.
exercises.prompt: A definite advantage of automatic doors is that people can't spread their contagious diseases by touching door handles.
exercises.why: **тот → том** (prep. sg. n., agreeing with люди). «тот» has its own declension (not the regular adjective pattern). Its forms (n. sg.): то · того · тому · то · тем · том.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
